signal_audit.hallucination_title: Hallucinated signals — cited values absent from ctx
signal_audit.hallucination_help: Personas quoted concrete numbers, but the signal was not in this round's prompt ctx — likely the LLM filled gaps from training data, or the regex collided with another signal. Inspect the underlying turn content before treating as fabrication.

sweep.title: Multi-day backtest sweep
sweep.subtitle: Anchor date + N trading days × M rounds each, stoppable mid-run
sweep.intro: From the anchor date forward, runs one backtest discussion per trading day for N days. Each discussion runs the configured rounds and auto-concludes. Topic / rules / personas are inherited from the form above.
sweep.auto_post_mortem_label: Auto post-mortem (inject next-day gainers + reflection round + revised conclusion after each conclude)
sweep.auto_post_mortem_on_help: Checked = after each spawned discussion concludes, auto-runs the post-mortem (D1-D5 self-eval + daily winners + reflection round + revised conclusion). ~50% cost overhead per date.
sweep.auto_post_mortem_off_help: Unchecked = only the original synthesis runs, no self-critique. Saves ~50% LLM cost but loses the reality-check loop.
sweep.reuse_note: This sweep will reuse the form above's topic / rules / {{personas}} personas.
